name: Incompetence
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, mesmerist 1, precog 1, technomancer 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time ? 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause all targets of this spell to lose proficiency with one class of weapons of your choice: simple weapons, martial weapons, exotic weapons, firearms, heavy weaponry, natural weaponry, alchemical weapons (including grenades), or siege weapons. The targets suffer the normal penalty for attacks made with weapons they are not proficient with (usually a –4 penalty; see the Pathfinder Core Rulebook, pages 140–141). A creature with Weapon Focus or a similar feat that requires proficiency with a weapon loses the benefits of that feat while under the effects of this spell.
